create_resize_longest_side: create a ResizeLongestSide instance with a target length to resize images to the longest side
apply_image_resize: apply image resize to a numpy array with HxWxC shape in uint8 format
apply_coords_transform: apply coordinate transformation to map pixel coordinates from original to resized image dimensions
apply_boxes_transform: apply bounding box transformation to map Bx4 boxes from original to resized image dimensions
apply_image_torch_resize: apply batched image resize to a torch tensor with BCHW float format using bilinear interpolation
